major_events: 牧尘 defeats 邱北海 (青天灵院) in one-on-two combat, severing his remaining fingers and breaking his spirit — '第四百六十章 邱北海'
牧尘 confronts 夏侯 (圣灵院四圣子, 灵力难) and matches him blow-for-blow, establishing 北苍灵院's right to remain at the ancient ruin site — '第四百六十九章 黑暗森林'
The dark forest's demonic trees and corrosive poison雾 are discovered; 牧尘 absorbs the poison to replenish his depleted 毒指 — '第四百七十章 魔树' / '第四百七十一章 补充毒指'
A fake 仙灵树 (actually 魔灵树) lures greedy teams to their deaths; 牧尘 uses 林州's jade token to trigger the real ancient palace's emergence — '第四百七十五章 宫殿'
牧尘 defeats the 青木傀儡 and claims five 仙灵果 plus the entire 仙灵树, distributing fruit to teammates for 肉身难 attempts — '第四百七十六章 取宝'
The mysterious 木灵院 team (甄青 leading) ambushes 牧尘 inside the palace, stealing a leaf-shaped control seal from the 青木雕像 — '第四百七十七章 木灵院'
洛璃 unleashes 洛神剑莲, severing nine enemies' arms simultaneously in a devastating group attack — '第四百八十八章 洛神剑莲'
牧尘's team physically carries the massive 木神卫 through a collapsing space rift as the palace self-destructs — '第四百九十章 扛走'
牧尘 erases 甄青's spiritual brand from the control seal using 九幽火 and claims the 木神卫, the 青木甲 (绝品灵器), and the 青木碑 — '第四百九十一章 战利品'
The 青木碑 reveals the true 木神殿 location and the 九阳神芝, one of three materials needed for 大日不灭身 — '第四百九十二章 收获'
牧尘 endures 20+ days of 肉身难 torture (far exceeding normal 7-8 days) due to his abnormally strong body — '第四百九十三章 渡肉身难' / '第四百九十四章 苦难'
温清璇 arrives, fights 牧尘 to test his strength, then proposes an alliance for the 木神殿 expedition — '第四百九十七章 温清璇' / '第五百章 合作'
血天都 (血神族四皇子) appears to abduct 洛璃; 牧尘 clashes with him using five-pattern 雷神体 — '第五百零三章 血天都'
牧尘 assembles all six 木神碑 fragments, obtaining the 木神经 (大神术) and the auxiliary 种树诀 — '第五百四十九章 凑齐木神碑' / '第五百五十一章 木神经'
姬玄 launches '灭尘行动' with 柳青云, 方云, and 血天河 as allies; 牧尘 counters with 武灵 and 温不胜 — '第五百八十一章 出牌' / '第五百八十二章 阵容对峙'
牧尘 vs 姬玄 solo battle at the 决战赛: 姬玄 reveals 三重神魄难 and 远古天龙鹰 possession — '第五百八十三章 惊天对碰' / '第五百八十四章 三重神魄难VS七纹雷体'
九幽 awakens from evolution as 九幽冥雀 (四品至尊) and lends power to 牧尘, turning the tide — '第六百三十二章 九幽再现' / '第六百三十三章 九幽之力'
牧尘 uses the 曼荼罗封印 from 不朽之页 to seal the 远古天龙鹰, then destroys 姬玄's body and神魄 — '第六百三十五章 曼荼罗' / '第六百三十六章 斩草除根'
牧尘 wins the 灵院大赛 championship for 北苍灵院 — '第六百三十七章 冠军'
洛天神 (地至尊) arrives with 雷鹤军团 to take 洛璃 back to 洛神族; 牧尘 promises to become a 盖世强者 and reclaim her — '第六百四十章 洛天神' / '第六百四十二章 分离'
牧尘 learns from 九幽 that 万古不朽身 is one of ten 原始法身, ranking 4th among 99 至尊法身 — '第六百四十三章 原始法身'
牧尘 shatters his 气海 to form 至尊海, ascending to 至尊境 — '第六百四十四章 晋升至尊'
牧尘 departs 北苍灵院 with 九幽 via transmission array; 灵溪 also secretly leaves — '第六百四十八章 离开'
牧尘 fuses 不死火 into his spiritual power during the two-month journey, gaining 灵性 and self-sustaining off-body attacks — '第六百五十章 融合不死火'
牧尘 fights 柳冥 (天玄殿少殿主, 天炎法身) — his first battle against a true 至尊 in the Great Thousand World — '第六百六十章 大千世界第一战'
牧尘 defeats 柳冥 using the three-lotus 妖莲屠灵阵 (灵阵大师 level), then faces 八品至尊 人魔长老 — '第六百六十二章 三莲形态' / '第六百六十三章 变故'
林静's mother (武境主母, 地至尊) appears and defeats 人魔长老 with 天地之相, revealing 林静 as 武境小公主 — '第六百六十四章 神秘的白衣女子' / '第六百六十五章 武境主母，绫清竹'
牧尘 enters 大罗天域, attends 九王会议, and defeats 赵忠 to secure 九幽宫's 大罗金池 quota — '第六百七十三章 震慑' / '第六百七十四章 打死'
牧尘 successfully cultivates 大日不灭身 using 九阳灵芝, 虚空大日果, 不灭神叶, and 50,000 drops of 至尊灵液 — '第六百七十六章 九阳为体，大日淬身' / '第六百七十七章 法身成！'
牧尘 masters the 九龙九象术 by combining 紫焰 (不死火) and 黑色雷霆 as opposing attributes — '第六百七十九章 诡异的九龙九象术'
大罗金池之争 begins; 牧尘 faces four 一品至尊 peak attackers (北邙四谷) sent by 血鹰王 — '第六百八十三章 战四至尊' / '第六百八十四章 雷霆手段'
character_state_transitions: 牧尘: 通天境后期 → 肉身难 (after 20-day ordeal) → 灵力难 (after second seclusion) → 至尊境 (气海 shattering) — progressive cultivation across the entire chunk
洛璃: 肉身难 → 灵力难 → 一重神魄难 (revealed post-seclusion) → taken back to 洛神族 by 洛天神
徐荒/赵青衫/慕风扬: 通天境后期 → 肉身难 (with 仙灵果 aid, 5-6 days) → 灵力难 (second seclusion)
邱北海: confident antagonist with two肉身难 allies → psychologically broken, all fingers severed, abandons teammates and flees
温清璇: mysterious排名第一 rival → tested ally → reveals possessive interest in 洛璃 (declared '我要把洛璃抢过来')
姬玄: undefeated灵院大赛 leader (三重神魄难 + 远古天龙鹰) → defeated, body destroyed, 神魄 heavily damaged by 牧尘/九幽
九幽: dormant/evolving throughout early chapters → awakens as 九幽冥雀 (四品至尊, 不死火) → active companion lending power
洛璃: active companion and fighter → separated from 牧尘, departing with 洛天神 to 洛神族, leaving 牧尘 with a promise
牧尘: 北苍灵院 student/champion → departed into 大千世界 → 九幽宫统领 in 大罗天域
牧尘: no至尊法身 → successfully cultivated 大日不灭身 (ranked within top 50 of 99至尊法身)
林静: mysterious travel companion → revealed as 武境小公主 (daughter of 武祖's武境)
唐冰: non-至尊九幽卫 manager → broke through to 至尊境 during牧尘's大日不灭身 cultivation period
沈苍生/李玄通/苏萱 team: disappeared since灵院大赛 start → emerged from荒谷 with massive power gains (灵力难 level)
血天都: threatening血神族 prince → defeated and fleeing with heavy injuries from牧尘's组合灵阵
long_form_mechanisms: Cultivation tribulation ladder: 通天境 → 肉身难 (blood-fire tempering) → 灵力难 (spiritual power transformation) → 神魄难 (three stages) → 至尊境 (气海 shattering into 至尊海), each requiring increasingly dangerous and prolonged ordeals
灵院大赛 scoring and ranking system: 院牌-based分数 accumulation, top 16 → top 8 → 决战赛 bracket, with teams balancing分数-hunting versus遗迹 exploration for power
远古遗迹 exploration as power-escalation engine: teams seek ancient ruins (木神殿, etc.) for treasures, inheritances, and cultivation materials that shortcut normal progression
九幽血脉链接: 牧尘 and 九幽 share a blood link enabling power lending — 九幽 can lend四品至尊 level power to牧尘, limited by his body's承受 capacity
大日不灭身 cultivation quest: three rare materials (九阳神芝, 虚空大日果, 不灭神叶) plus massive至尊灵液 (50,000 drops) required; only one chance, failure = permanent exclusion
木神经 + 种树诀 combo system: 大神术 whose power depends on forest环境; 种树诀 (a planting technique) creates instant forests to provide optimal battlefield conditions

至尊灵力灵性/属性融合: At至尊境, spiritual power must be fused with special substances (不死火, 天炎, etc.) to gain属性 and 'spirituality,' dramatically increasing combat power and enabling self-sustaining off-body attacks
至尊法身 system: 99 ranks with原始法身 (top 5) at the apex; cultivation requires自身灵力 for雏形, materials for strengthening, and至尊灵液 for completion — 大日不灭身 uses 'break and rebuild' via不灭神叶
大罗天域 political hierarchy: 域主 → 三皇 (天鹫皇/灵瞳皇/睡皇) → 九王 → 统领, with internal resource competition (大罗金池名额) governed by rules (王不能出手, only麾下争夺)
灵阵师 parallel progression: 牧尘 advances from五级灵阵 to灵阵大师 (一级人品), with妖莲屠灵阵 scaling from two-lotus to three-lotus form, providing a combat edge against至尊法身 users
continuity_observations: 邱北海's missing fingers and灵路 backstory (围剿洛璃, being姬玄's ally) are consistently referenced from prior灵路 events — '第四百六十章 邱北海'

style_observations: Battle scenes employ sequential 'trump card reveals' — each side holds hidden techniques unleashed in escalating order, creating multi-phase combat that can span 5-10 chapters for a single fight
Crowd reactions ('骇然/震慑/倒吸凉气') serve as a narrative power-scaling device: spectator commentary establishes relative strength without direct exposition
Romantic intimacy is structured around interruption patterns — physical closeness is consistently broken by external events (林州 waking, battle alarms), maintaining tension across hundreds of chapters
Female characters receive extensive physical description upon introduction (玉腿/娇躯/酥胸 imagery), with combat capability framed as surprising contrast to beauty
Chapter titles function as spoiler-hooks, naming key events or techniques (e.g., '法身成！', '斩草除根', '冠军'), creating anticipation before reading
The author uses internal monologue flashbacks during critical moments (牧尘 recalling promises to洛璃 and his father during肉身难 torture) to anchor character motivation
Power system terminology follows a grandiose naming convention: [cosmic element] + [mythical form] + [technique name] (e.g., '四神封天印', '洛神剑莲', '大日不灭身', '万古不朽身')

evidence: Character names牧尘, 洛璃, 姬玄, 温清璇 are consistent with大主宰's established cast
The大千世界 cosmology with至尊法身 (99 ranks), 原始法身 (top 5), and至尊者 as power milestones matches天蚕土豆's late-stage power system
The cultivation progression structure (academy → tournament → wider world) mirrors patterns from斗破苍穹 (萧炎/迦南学院/丹塔) and武动乾坤 (林动/道宗/百朝大战)
The 'beautiful girl taken back by powerful family, hero vows to become strong enough to reclaim her' trope echoes萧炎/萧薰儿's separation in斗破苍穹
Tournament arc with bracket progression, team scoring, and escalating opponents follows天蚕土豆's signature competition structure
The blood-linked beast companion (九幽) lending power at critical moments parallels类似 companion mechanisms in his other works
Spectator-reaction-driven power scaling and sequential trump-card battle reveals are characteristic of天蚕土豆's combat writing style
The '不朽图录/万古不朽身' as a multi-volume cultivation objective requiring rare materials echoes异火收集 in斗破苍穹

originality_risks: The灵院大赛 tournament structure (team scoring, top-16/top-8 brackets, 决战赛) is a standard xianxia/web-novel competition trope with minimal structural innovation
The 'hidden trump card' battle formula where each side reveals increasingly powerful techniques in sequential phases is highly formulaic across the author's oeuvre and the genre
The 'beautiful girl recalled by powerful family, hero swears to become盖世强者' separation device is nearly identical to斗破苍穹's萧薰儿 arc, risking self-plagiarism
The post-academy 'entering a larger world and competing for position in a hierarchical organization' (大罗天域: 三皇→九王→统领) closely mirrors standard progression-fantasy patterns
The blood-linked beast companion (九幽) awakening at the critical moment to lend overwhelming power is a deus ex machina device common in the author's works
Power escalation via material collection (大日不灭身's three ingredients) parallels异火 collection in斗破苍穹, risking repetitive quest structure
